description: Java class defining REST API resource for self share products in Fineract, including endpoints to retrieve specific or all share products with validation and delegation to underlying services.

classes.name: SelfShareProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for self share products, handling product retrieval endpoints with validation.

methods.name: retrieveProduct
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific share product by productId, validating client mapping.

methods.name: retrieveAllProducts
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all share products with optional pagination, validating client mapping.
